newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar mostly up by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar mostly up by close.

text.p: White sugar futures were flat to mostly higher by the close although prices were well below their session highs.
Traders said switch deals were active as the further forwards attracted more interest.
"The (March/May) spread is remaining steady but it's the quietest day of the week, the majority of March is on a switch basis," said one trader.
"It's a mixture of nothing," he said, noting trade interest to buy August/October from broker sellers.
By the close, March stood 50 cents firmer at $304.80 a tonne while May was unchanged at $301.80. Overall turnover amounted to 2,078 lots.

Physical news was thin on the ground although Iran is expected to be in the market next week to buy 14,000 tonnes of white sugar for April shipment after cancelling its tender this week due to higher world prices.
